item.title: Ask to Swap a Library Book
item.prompt_text: You borrowed a long book for your reading group. Your group meets next Tuesday, and you have only read the first chapter. Write to the library asking to swap the book for a shorter mystery. You can visit on Saturday morning.
item.target_grammar: Present perfect for progress; could I for requests; time phrases.
item.target_structure: Greeting → problem → specific request → visit time → thanks.

checklist.point: Explain why you need a different book.
